#BLM Co-Founder @aliciagarza responds to @corybooker: 

"7 years ago, people thought that #BLM was a radical idea. And yet 'black lives matter' ... [is] being discussed across kitchen tables all over the world. Why can't we start to look at how we reorganize our priorities?"

#BLM Co-Founder @aliciagarza to @CoryBooker on #MTP:

"Are we willing to live in fear that our lives will be taken by police officers who are literally using their power in the wrong way? Or are we willing to ... absorb the fear of what it might mean to change our practices?"

. @CoryBooker, #BLM Co-Founder @aliciagarza discuss #defundthepolice. @stavridisj says he's concerned over the lack of moral authority. The founding director of African American History and Culture museum calls for America to confront its racial past.
